dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Senior Researcher. You mean, "What is there to even visit here"?

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Well, if we want to get specific about potential attractions... I guess it would be the airborne Central Laboratory.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: According to Messieurs Raimondo and Choiseul, the institute will convert that laboratory into a Safety Exhibition.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Inside, there will be pictures from all the Institute's old research projects...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Though... I don't see what those projects have to do with a Safety Exhibition...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: And would anyone want to visit such an exhibition...
